title.zh: 将伊富高省的Lista市镇更名为Alfonso Lista市镇，并作出相应规定的法案
title.en: An Act Renaming the Municipality of Lista in the Province of Ifugao as the Municipality of Alfonso Lista
title.orig: An Act Renaming the Municipality of Lista in the Province of Ifugao as the Municipality of Alfonso Lista

text.en: The Municipality of Lista in the Province of Ifugao is hereby renamed as Alfonso Lista.

The renaming of the Municipality of Lista shall be effective upon ratification of the majority of the votes cast by qualified voters in a plebiscite to be conducted and supervised by the Commission on Elections (COMELEC) in the present Municipality of Lista.
The expenses for such plebiscite shall be borne by the Municipality of Lista, Province of Ifugao.
This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of general circulation.
